title: Pack Swaps
intro: Cards opened in packs, each beside the deck card it could replace. Upgrades, sidegrades and spice picks only.

swaps.why: Equipment with removal: on entering, an opponent's creature gets -2/-2; then +2/+0. Orzhov Equipment, Standard-legal.
As in 26: a Robot that turns artifact spells into flying Drones.
swaps.cut_note: an artifact-enters payoff; Leyline makes either a Robot

swaps.why: Instant: 3 damage to an opponent's creature; their other creatures can't block Giants or Warriors that turn.
swaps.cut_note: X-cost modal sorcery

swaps.why: Two Treasures, then chapter III tutors any Equipment (Embercleave, Kaldra) to hand.
swaps.cut_note: also an Equipment tutor; it also cheats one in

swaps.why: A Treasure for every instant you cast on your own creature; +1/+0 per artifact.
swaps.cut_note: also rewards casting instants

swaps.why: Cascade on cast plus +4/+0 and trample; much weaker than Embercleave, but owned.
swaps.cut_note: a stand-in until it is crafted

swaps.why: Equip by paying 3 life; the creature conjures an attacking Ball Lightning on every attack.
swaps.cut_note: a stand-in until it is crafted

swaps.why: Damage to an opponent equal to noncreature spells cast since your last turn.
2 damage to each opponent per instant or sorcery you cast; worth it only with a high spell count.
Instant: damage equal to your greatest power (Samut makes that huge) to a creature or planeswalker, exiling it if it would die.
swaps.cut_note: a sorcery bite

swaps.why: Taps for mana equal to its power (Samut's +X/+0 counts) and adds an extra counter whenever counters go on.
swaps.cut_note: land ramp off creatures entering

swaps.why: An Aura that doubles the creature's +1/+1 counters every upkeep; a fast-growing threat for Samut.
swaps.cut_note: a counters card in a power deck

swaps.why: A Zombie with deathtouch; exploit (sacrifice a creature, e.g. a token) to tutor any card.
swaps.cut_note: 5-drop needing an unblocked attacker

swaps.why: Other Zombies get +1/+1, and the deck runs 22 Zombies. (Its snow recursion is dead here.)
swaps.cut_note: also a 5-drop; flying for Zombie tokens instead of +1/+1 for all Zombies

swaps.why: Instant: target player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker, or make a 2/1 flier.
swaps.cut_note: sorcery destroy, Zombie later

swaps.why: Exiles a card from a graveyard each combat; adapt {1}{B} brings an exiled creature back hasty for the turn, and every extra combat is another exile.
swaps.cut_note: 5-mana reanimation that needs combat damage first

swaps.why: 3-mana Saga: 4 damage to a creature, then you take control of it for combat; later chapters add value.
swaps.cut_note: 5-mana instant, 5 damage

swaps.why: A Merfolk that puts +1/+1 counters ({3}{G}) and turns a counter into a card ({2}{U}); Zimone doubles counters.
swaps.cut_note: not a Merfolk; also its stored printing is flagged unverified

swaps.why: Fetch a basic; it becomes a land creature with +1/+1 counters, which Zimone then doubles.
swaps.cut_note: two turns of creature mana, then a counter each

swaps.why: +1 locks down a creature; −X copies a permanent card from your graveyard (thin in an opponent-mill deck). A walker to hold the board.
swaps.cut_note: also a non-mill walker

swaps.why: 6-mana walker: two 2/2 Wolves each turn, or −3 destroy a creature and draw.
swaps.cut_note: a stand-in; Ob's +1 draw is a mill under the Tutelages, so Ob stays the better card

swaps.why: Every untap mills that permanent's controller: the opponent untaps more, but it is symmetric.
Three Foods when cast from hand; returns from the graveyard by sacrificing three Foods. {G}{G}{G}{G}.
3-mana Aura: tap the creature and keep it tapped; {U}{U} shuffles it away. A noncreature spell for G'raha.
swaps.cut_note: flash, also stops activated abilities

swaps.why: 1-mana Aura: the creature loses all abilities and becomes a 0/2. A cheap noncreature spell for G'raha.
swaps.cut_note: 3 mana; its proliferate also grows Hero tokens

swaps.why: 2 mana for two Borg artifact creatures, feeding Collation Trimatrix's tap-three draw and Borg Cube's affinity.
swaps.cut_note: not an artifact creature, so it feeds none of the deck's counts

swaps.why: A 3-mana artifact CREATURE that taps for any colour and scries 2; it counts for Borg Cube and Collation Trimatrix.
swaps.cut_note: a rock that counts for neither

swaps.why: Counter a noncreature spell, {1} cheaper per artifact you control or hold; instant-speed interaction the deck lacks.
swaps.cut_note: same 5 mana; a sorcery drain where this is instant interaction

swaps.why: Instant edict (creature or planeswalker), or a 2/1 flier.
swaps.cut_note: 2-mana instant edict
